verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device inference engine and model fine-tuning platform (models, bindings, CLI, training API). An integrated document-drafting workspace with autosave belongs to a different product category, and nothing in the evidence shows Cactus ships such an editor, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an AI agent draft and edit documents in an integrated workspace with changes saved automatically
